title: Israel’s Next Chapter: Election Results and the Road Ahead
text:
Israel’s Next Chapter: Election Results and the Road Ahead

Israel’s Oct. 27 election has left the country facing political uncertainty, with both Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s bloc and the opposition alliance led by Gadi Eisenkot falling short of a parliamentary majority. As the first national vote since the October 7, 2023 Hamas attacks and the ensuing regional war, the election offered a critical test of how the past three years have reshaped Israeli politics. As coalition negotiations loom, what do the results reveal about Israeli public opinion, the country’s security priorities and its approach to the Palestinians and the wider region? And what could the outcome mean for Israel’s relationship with Washington and its neighbors in the region?AL-MONITOR hosted a live discussion on October 29, 2026 on the results of Israel's election with Ben Caspit, Nadia Bilbassy-Charters, Ambassador Daniel B. Shapiro, and moderated by Andrew Parasiliti.
